thread:
maya: Heads-up — I just found a case in the audit logs where an API key with only the `embeddings:generate` scope successfully called the chat endpoint and returned 200. Not sure if this is an RBAC regression after the roles/permissions refactor.

sam: Can you paste the raw audit line?

maya: Sure, here's the log snippet (sanitized):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-15T03:14:22Z","event":"request","route":"/v1/chat.generate","token_id":"tok_6X***","token_scopes":["embeddings:generate"],"model":"redwood-chat-xl","status":200,"resp_time_ms":142}
```

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: scope-mismatch-detection — token tok_6X*** used route /v1/chat.generate at 2026-03-15T03:14:22Z

lina: Did we rotate any keys or change KMS configs around that time? KMS rotation landed last night but shouldn’t affect scope claims.

maya: We did KMS key rotation at 2026-03-15T03:12Z. Token IDs are unchanged (we use signing keys keyed by kid). My guess is either: cached JWKs accepted a stale signing key, or the route-level permission check was bypassed after the RBAC refactor.

nick: I dug into the auth middleware quickly — after the refactor we moved from `enforceScopeForRoute(req, token)` to a lighter `enforceOperation(token, opName)` for some endpoints. Looks like chat endpoints call `opName: "generate"` while the token has `embeddings:generate`, so mismatch checks end up being truthy because we substring-match `generate` in several places. Bad. Example buggy code: 
```js
// old: precise check
return token.scopes.includes(`${routeType}:generate`)
// new (bug): loose check
return token.scopes.some(s => s.includes('generate'))
```

sam: I can reproduce locally — created a test key with only `embeddings:generate` and hit `/v1/chat.generate` -> 200 and valid completion returned. Repro steps in case useful: 
```
export KEY=tok_test_emb_only
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"model":"redwood-chat-xl"}'
```

lina: Okay we need immediate mitigations:
- Block tokens that have `embeddings:` scopes from calling chat endpoints at the gateway layer (WAF) until auth fix is deployed.
- Emit an audit event flagged `scope_enforced:false` for all earlier requests so we can query the window.

maya: Agreed. I can push a small WAF rule to the edge to reject requests where header token scopes contain `embeddings:generate` + route matches `/v1/chat.*`. Temporary but fast. Also will open a PR for the auth-service fix (tighten check).

nick: For the auth fix we should: 1) revert to exact match checks for route+operation, 2) add unit tests for embeddings vs chat mismatch, 3) add an integration test that runs in staging against a token with single scope. I'll draft the PR.

sam: Also let's rotate any keys that we find were actually used for cross-scope access. Lina — can you query the audit logs for tokens with mismatched usage in the last 2 hours and list token_ids? We should rotate the affected tokens and revoke them.

lina: On it. Running queries now. Will post list and scope of impact in a follow-up.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline: patch/waf-quick-block -> prod edge rule started (ID: edge-rule-1123)

maya: After WAF rule applied, I re-ran the curl from above and got 403. Good. Next: PR with fix + tests; will request review from @nick and @sam.

nick: I'll add logging fields: `scope_enforced` (bool), `token_kid`, and `auth_check_version` in auth-service logs so postmortem can correlate KMS rotation windows. Also recommend adding an alert: `scope-enforcement-fail-rate > 0.1%` to catch regressions.

sam: Triage: Severity = P2 (medium) because it may allow limited privilege escalation per key, but no data exfiltration observed yet.

lina: Audit query returned 7 token_ids with cross-route usage in the 03:10–03:20 window. Rotating/revoking now, posting a revocation batch id once done.

maya: Thanks. Action items tracked: 
- WAF block applied (maya) ✅
- Auth-service strict check PR (maya -> nick review) 🛠️
- Add extra audit fields (nick) 🧾
- Rotate affected tokens (lina) 🔒
- Add staging integration test (sam) 🧪

maya: I'll schedule a quick postmortem doc after we finish actions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
